subject: Admin activity export cadence, sampling, and delivery options for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: compliance@medicosys.com
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jane.auditor@auditfirm.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity and export cadence

Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 audit window we need a few clarifications about Redwood's admin activity logging. Specifically:

- What events are included in the admin activity stream (role changes, API key rotation, console sign-ins, dedicated instance changes, routings)?
- Retention policy for that data and whether we can request a 90-day slice on demand vs. a full export.
- Export formats you can provide (JSONL, Parquet, compressed docs) and whether manifests are signed.
- Any available sampling approaches for high-volume tenants so we don't transfer terabytes for this scope.

I've attached our questionnaire worksheet (medicosys-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx). Jane will coordinate the audit schedule. Ideally we would receive an initial manifest and a 30‑day sample by next Friday.

Best,
Sara Collins
Head of Compliance
MedicoSys

--- attachment: medicosys-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
To: compliance@medicosys.com
Cc: jane.auditor@auditfirm.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity and export cadence

Sara / Jane,

Thanks — happy to help. Short answers up front, details below:

- What we log: privileged role grants/revocations, console sign-ins (SAML & password failures), API key create/delete/rotate, model rollout/rollbacks, dedicated pool provisioning events, routings/fallback policy changes, and operator-run queries (admin-console queries). We also include the request origin IP, username, action, resource identifier, and a monotonic event id for linkage.
- Retention: default 13 months for admin activity; active customers can request up to 24 months under an enterprise contract.
- Export formats: we provide compressed JSONL (recommended), Parquet (columnar), and a tarball pre-signed manifest. Each manifest includes an HMAC and SHA256 checksums; we can also provide an attestation note for SOC evidence.
- Sampling: we support deterministic time-window sampling and event-type sampling (e.g., all role grants + 5% of console sign-ins). We can also provide a stratified sample keyed by tenant and event severity to keep the sample representative.

Action items:
1) I'll ingest your questionnaire and mark up the fields we can auto-fill.
2) Kimberly and Marissa — can you confirm whether we can produce a pre-signed manifest and HMAC for the 30-day sample by Friday (attached: admin-activity-manifest-v1.jsonl.gz)?
3) Sara — let me know if MedicoSys prefers JSONL or Parquet for the initial pull. If you pick JSONL we'll include the attached manifest and a short readme.

Diego
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: admin-activity-manifest-v1.jsonl.gz (placeholder, 18MB)
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com; marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity and export cadence

Diego — quick operational notes:

- We can generate the 30-day JSONL sample with HMAC by Friday EOD. The pipeline will pull events using the event id range and produce compressed shards keyed by tenant id.
- For exports larger than ~200GB we recommend Parquet+S3 transfer; for smaller slices JSONL tar.gz is fine.
- Sampling: default stratified sampler uses tenant_id + event_type to preserve rare but high-severity actions (role grants, key rotations). That aligns with SOC reviewers' expectations.
- Privacy redaction: we will redact any PII in free-text fields and include an anonymization map in the manifest.

Marissa — please schedule the extraction job in the runbook and add the checksum step. Rishi — can you confirm auditor access policy (time-limited presigned URL vs SFTP push)?

Kimberly
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com; kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity and export cadence

All — scheduled the extraction for Thu 2026-11-05 02:00 UTC (low traffic window). Notes:

- Job will emit 4GB shards in JSONL, compressed with gzip, and upload to a restricted S3 bucket.
- We'll produce a manifest.jsonl.gz that lists shard names, checksums, total event count, sample method, and redaction map.
- I'll attach an ephemeral access policy that grants Jane read-only presigned URLs valid for 72 hours. If MedicoSys requests direct SFTP push, we can do that but it will add ~24h for transfer ops.

Also, for the on-demand 90-day slice: because of tenant volume we suggest a staged approach — provide a representative 30-day sample first, then bulk export on signed handoff if the auditor needs full fidelity.

Marissa
Product Ops Manager, Evidence & Export
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: extraction-runbook-step-attachments.txt (stub, 2KB)
From: jane.auditor@auditfirm.com
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com; marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@medicosys.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence: admin activity and export cadence

Thanks — that timeline works. A couple of clarifying points from the audit team:

1) For the manifest HMAC, can you indicate who signs it (Redwood ops key) and whether we can get the public verification key in PEM format?
2) On redaction: please include a short mapping of redacted tokens to replacement categories (e.g., <USER_ID_REDACTED> -> user_id_hash), so our testing team can validate event lineage without seeing raw PII.

If you can send the presigned URLs and the verification key as soon as the run completes, we'll begin ingest and aim to provide initial findings within 3 business days.

Jane Walker
Senior Auditor
Audit & Assurance Group

--- note: no additional attachments requested
